## GitHub Issue Labeler and Assigner
Receives GitHub issue webhooks, analyzes title/body keywords, auto-adds labels, assigns team members, and logs to Sheets.

**Setup:**
1. Configure GitHub webhook for 'issues' events
2. Set GitHub token in HTTP Header Auth (Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN)
3. Customize keyword-to-label rules in the Code node
4. Customize keyword-to-assignee rules for your team
5. Connect Google Sheets for issue tracking
